title: The Ancient Magus' Bride — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about The Ancient Magus' Bride. The Ancient Magus' Bride (Japanese: 魔法使いの嫁, Hepburn: Mahō Tsukai no Yome) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Kore Yamazaki. It is serialized in Bushiroad Works' Comic Growl manga website and is licensed in North America by Seven Seas Entertainment.

Meaning is not found in The Ancient Magus' Bride — it is manufactured for it. An ancient fae who gives Chise a magical fox skin that she can use to mutate into a were-animal of her choosing. Ashen Eye is spiteful towards humans to the point he will use them to amuse himself.
